summary: Market snapshot derives the existing nullable is_digital value from listing_type: download and both are digital, physical is not, and unknown values remain NULL. Matching ignores case and surrounding spaces.
reason: Etsy ShopListing search responses expose listing_type, not is_digital. This Etsy-specific hand-written snapshot decoder and writer must preserve that API mapping without changing the schema or read paths. Synthetic fixtures and an HTTP-to-store regression test guard against restoring the nonexistent listing field.
validated_outcome: Peer code + test review 2026-11-18 (both SHIP). mutation-verify.sh, serial in-place copies: M1 restore json:"is_digital" decode -> CAUGHT by TestMarketSnapshotListingTypeDigital (knock-out -skip exited 0, one fewer RUN line); M2 both->0 -> CAUGHT by TestMktDigitalFromListingType/both (knock-out exited 0). Controls went RED for their own reason (tool label UNVERIFIED CONTROL). Accepted Minor: e2e test now also sends listing_type both and PHYSICAL; a both-unmapped mutant fails it (listing 1000000004 got NULL, want 1).
